source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 560 searches beside the installed executable in chrome/icons/default and prefers TB-symbolic.svg on GNOME-derived desktops. 569 adds SVG files to the Unix package manifest and allows the duplicate symbolic asset; its commit says Daily did not ship that asset and the tray icon was broken on GNOME. The current locator still canonicalizes the runtime path and can fall back to a theme name. A checked-in SVG is insufficient unless the packaging manifest installs it at the requested case-sensitive name. No installed Daily or GNOME environment was tested.
title: Match runtime icon lookup with shipped resource paths
